assumptions.statement: Official polygons, regulatory controls, road redlines, ownership, municipal, fire, heritage and engineering constraints are unavailable.
assumptions.impact: All spatial and implementation moves remain conceptual and must be recalculated or redesigned after official data review.

assumptions.statement: Station-area extents for the 7 design-area stations are measured walking isochrones, not circles: 16 bearings per station, 784 real walking routes from the Amap walking-route API measured 2026-08-09, reduced to the straight-line distance each bearing reaches on a 75 m/min walking budget. Station origins are real station coordinates, not key-area polygon centroids. The 14 coordinated-research-area stations are not measured and use a circle at the measured median detour of 1.75, labelled as an estimate on the drawings.
assumptions.impact: Supersedes the earlier radius = minutes * 75 / 1.35 circle, which was wrong two ways: the measured median detour is 1.75, so the seven 15-minute rings claimed 1526 ha against 961 ha actually reachable, overstating by 37%; and reachable extent is not circular at all, ranging at 学知园 from 284 m on the clear bearing to 38 m across 京藏高速. Residual survey items: the Amap network does not account for crossing signal delay, walled breaks or accessibility, and station entrances are still OpenStreetMap points rather than surveyed entrances.

assumptions.statement: No audited pedestrian network, crossing delay, barrier, accessibility or night-safety baseline is available.
assumptions.impact: Performance targets remain survey items and no travel-time improvement is claimed.

assumptions.statement: TOD value uplift may displace ordinary residents, workers and small businesses unless protections precede development.
assumptions.impact: Affordable rental housing, basic retail and small-business safeguards are treated as mandatory policy directions, subject to legal review.
